scripts.dev: bun run dev:check && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:check: bun run setup:env && bun run setup:deps
scripts.dev:backend: cd server && bash -c 'if ! venv/bin/python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then bash scripts/setup_venv.sh; else venv/bin/python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi; exec venv/bin/python3 src/server.py'
scripts.dev:frontend: cd web && AGENT_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun run dev
scripts.frontend: cd web && AGENT_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8000 bun run dev
scripts.setup: bun run setup:env && bun run setup:backend && bun run setup:frontend && bun run setup:done
scripts.setup:env:
test -f server/.env.local || (cp server/.env.example server/.env.local && echo '
Created server/.env.local. Add AGORA_APP_ID, AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE, and GOOGLE_API_KEY before running the app.')
scripts.setup:deps: test -d node_modules || (echo 'Installing workspace dependencies...' && bun install)
scripts.setup:done:
echo '
✅ Setup complete! Next steps:' && echo '   1. Run: agora project env write server/.env.local' && echo '   2. Run: bun run dev
'
scripts.doctor: bash -c 'set -e; echo "Checking shared repo prerequisites..."; command -v bun >/dev/null && echo "- bun available" || { echo "- bun not found"; exit 1; }; test -d node_modules && echo "- workspace dependencies installed" || { echo "- root node_modules missing; run bun install"; exit 1; }'
scripts.doctor:local: bash -c 'set -e; bun run doctor; command -v python3 >/dev/null && echo "- python3 available" || { echo "- python3 not found"; exit 1; }; test -f server/.env.local && echo "- server/.env.local present" || { echo "- missing server/.env.local"; exit 1; }; grep -Eq "^AGORA_APP_ID=.+$" server/.env.local && echo "- AGORA_APP_ID configured" || { echo "- AGORA_APP_ID missing in server/.env.local"; exit 1; }; grep -Eq "^AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE=.+$" server/.env.local && echo "- AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE configured" || { echo "- AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE missing in server/.env.local"; exit 1; }; grep -Eq "^GOOGLE_API_KEY=.+$" server/.env.local && echo "- GOOGLE_API_KEY configured" || { echo "- GOOGLE_API_KEY missing in server/.env.local"; exit 1; }'
scripts.verify:local: bun run doctor:local && bun run verify:backend && bun run verify:local:fastapi && bun run verify:web:proxy && bun run verify:web:build
scripts.verify:backend: cd server && venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile src/server.py src/agent.py
scripts.verify:web: bun run doctor && bun run verify:web:api && bun run verify:web:build
scripts.clean: bun run clean:backend && bun run clean:frontend
scripts.dev:parallel: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd server && PORT=8110 venv/bin/python3 src/server.py" "cd web && AGENT_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8110 bunx next dev --webpack"
